name: Hero
summary: Unified container-responsive editorial Hero with full, split, and text-only layouts; optional fullscreen sizing; classified media, canonical actions, complete parallax or slideshow behavior, accessible controls, optional autoplay, loop policy, and visual timing feedback.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Named section, container and positioning context; omitted when the required title is empty.

anatomy.name: inner
anatomy.description: Required internal layout owner for container-responsive full, split and text-only composition.

anatomy.name: media
anatomy.description: Optional classified single-media or slideshow region, omitted for text-only presentation.

anatomy.name: track
anatomy.description: Slideshow-only native horizontal scroll-snap track that composes canonical Carousel.

anatomy.name: slide
anatomy.description: Ordered real slide group; slides are never cloned for looping.

anatomy.name: overlay
anatomy.description: Optional visual contrast layer nested within media and omitted without media.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Required non-empty primary heading whose native rank follows the host document.

anatomy.name: controls
anatomy.description: Slideshow-only control region containing canonical Icon Buttons and/or indicators.

anatomy.name: indicators
anatomy.description: Optional set of direct slide-selection buttons.

anatomy.name: rotationControl
anatomy.description: Visible Pause/Play Icon Button whenever autoplay is enabled.

anatomy.name: progress
anatomy.description: Autoplay-only visual current-slide timing bar; hidden from assistive technology.

anatomy.name: status
anatomy.description: Polite slideshow position status updated only when the selected slide changes.

variants.name: full
variants.description: Centered foreground content over optional full-bleed media.

variants.name: split
variants.description: Media and content columns that stack from Hero container width.

variants.name: text-only
variants.description: Text-only presentation that derives media, overlay, slideshow and motion as absent.

sizes.name: fullscreen
sizes.description: Viewport-height presentation independent from layout and media behavior.

states.name: default
states.description: Resting single-media, text-only or non-autoplay slideshow presentation.

states.name: currentSlide
states.description: Exactly one real slide is current.

states.name: autoplayPlaying
states.description: Autoplay timer and visual timing bar are both advancing.

states.name: autoplayPaused
states.description: Autoplay and visual timing bar are frozen by the user, hover, focus, hidden document or another pause reason.

states.name: reducedMotion
states.description: Automatic rotation, timing feedback, smooth scrolling and parallax are suppressed.

behavior.name: requiredTitleComposition
behavior.description: A non-empty title is a render precondition; invalid composition is omitted instead of emitting an empty heading.

behavior.name: coherentMediaComposition
behavior.description: Overlay is nested inside media and omitted without it; text-only derives media, overlay, slides, controls and motion as absent even when stale target data exists.

behavior.name: slideshowSelection
behavior.description: Previous, next, direct indicators and supplementary touch scrolling select one real slide, synchronize aria-current and update a polite position status. Root-wide arrow interception and cloned loop slides are forbidden.

behavior.name: loopPolicy
behavior.description: Loop defaults to true and wraps through logical index changes. With loop false, endpoint controls become disabled instead of cloning or wrapping slides.

behavior.name: autoplayLifecycle
behavior.description: Autoplay is opt-in and defaults off. It exposes one visible Pause/Play control, pauses on hover and focus-within, performs no hidden-document work, is disabled by reduced motion, and does not implicitly restart after manual slide navigation.

behavior.name: timingFeedback
behavior.description: One visual current-slide bar resets after navigation and freezes for every autoplay pause. It is aria-hidden and never announces changing percentages.

behavior.name: parallaxLifecycle
behavior.description: Progressive CSS scroll-driven translation applies only to classified single media; unsupported browsers retain a static image and reduced motion removes animation and transform.

behavior.name: mediaSemantics
behavior.description: Targets classify each image or video as informative or decorative and supply alternative text, native controls, captions, transcripts, consent and loading policy.

behavior.name: actionComposition
behavior.description: Actions compose canonical Button instances and preserve native navigation or command semantics.

behavior.name: ownershipStrategy
behavior.description: Static Web owns current-slide and optional autoplay state after initialization. Stateful adapters may control those same semantic values and events without replacing the real controls, track or slides.

properties.name: layout
properties.description: Full, split or text-only layout profile.

properties.name: height
properties.description: Intrinsic or fullscreen height independent from layout and media behavior.

properties.name: mediaBehavior
properties.description: Mutually exclusive single-media, parallax or slideshow behavior; text-only derives none.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Optional short context above the title.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Required non-empty primary hero heading; targets choose the native rank and omit the component when empty.

properties.name: media
properties.description: Target-owned classified single media; omitted for text-only and replaced by slides in slideshow behavior.

properties.name: overlay
properties.description: Optional visual scrim nested in existing media.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: Optional group of canonical Button actions.

properties.name: slides
properties.description: Ordered target-owned media slide groups used only by slideshow behavior.

properties.name: autoplay
properties.description: Enables optional timed rotation and requires visible Pause/Play plus visual timing feedback.

properties.name: loop
properties.description: Wraps previous/next through real slide indices without DOM clones.

properties.name: navigation
properties.description: Visible slideshow navigation controls; direct touch scrolling remains supplementary.

properties.name: autoplayInterval
properties.description: Autoplay interval in milliseconds; read only when autoplay is enabled.

properties.name: previousLabel
properties.description: Localized accessible label for the previous-slide Icon Button.

properties.name: nextLabel
properties.description: Localized accessible label for the next-slide Icon Button.

properties.name: pauseLabel
properties.description: Localized accessible label while the rotation control pauses autoplay.

properties.name: playLabel
properties.description: Localized accessible label while the rotation control resumes autoplay.

properties.name: statusTemplate
properties.description: Localized position template containing {current} and {total} placeholders.

accessibility: Use a heading level appropriate to the surrounding page hierarchy and omit the component when its required title is empty.
Classify media as informative or decorative; provide alternative text, controls, captions, transcripts and consent when required.
Keep overlay inside media and verify text contrast across every authored slide.
Name the slideshow region and each real slide group, expose current position politely, and keep previous, next, indicators and Pause/Play as native buttons.
Do not intercept horizontal arrows on the Hero root; keyboard operation belongs to focused controls and the scroll viewport.
Pause autoplay for hover, focus-within and hidden documents; suppress autoplay, timing feedback, smooth scrolling and parallax for reduced motion.
Keep the continuously changing timing bar visual and aria-hidden.
Compose actions with canonical Button and controls with canonical Icon Button and Carousel anatomy.

web.notes: Canonical CSS plus shared theme.js implement container layouts, progressive parallax, real-slide navigation, optional looping/autoplay, pause policy, reduced motion, timing feedback and native events.

shopify.notes: The canonical Hero section maps editor settings and slide blocks to the same contract and shared runtime.
